title: Koneko no Haitatsuin Uunyan
description:
Today’s the day Unyan the kitten becomes a delivery courier! Getting dressed, eating breakfast, packing his bag…He’s eager to get started, but there are so many firsts along the way! It’s a busy morning for this little kitten courier!

(Source: YouTube)

title: Temppal: Item no Chikara
description:
Sin Yeong-U (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title: Umayuru: Full Gate!
description: "Umayuru" is a short anime series featuring pint-sized Uma Musume! This time, it’s a "Full-Gate" three-minute race where *all* the Uma Musume take to the track! A super-sized, laid-back gathering with everyone!
